title: Rename across files
summary: Renaming a function edits its declaration, its definition and every call in the workspace; a spelling inside a macro is left alone and named in a message

rename.notice:
Spellings of `compute` left alone:
  ${WS}/a.h:4: #define CALL compute(1) (inside a preprocessor directive, which the index does not resolve)
  ${WS}/main.cpp:4: int use() { return compute(2) + CALL; } (the name is written here as `CALL`)
